lines.text: The disciples rebuke those bringing children to Jesus, but He welcomes the children and blesses them.
A man kneels before Jesus, asks how to inherit eternal life, and says he has kept the commandments since youth.
Jesus tells the man to sell everything and give to the priests, but he goes away in sorrow.
Jesus says an ox passing through a needle's eye is easier than a rich man entering God's kingdom.
Peter says they have left everything, and Jesus promises a hundredfold now and eternal life in the age to come.
